integrity: The bundled standalone finite checker reconstructs the claimed complex in two ways and checks all incidences, acyclicity, and the exact integral Morse differentials. It is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the bidirected three-dimensional cube is classified.
No complete homotopy type, integral equivariant representation, or higher-cube formula is claimed.
Torsion-freeness is proved using integral unit-pivot reductions, not inferred from modular tests.
title: Four-degree integral multipath homology of the bidirected three-cube
